reader.notes: BindString asks StrUnstrIsInteger (the one integer-operand classifier plus PicInfo.IsUnscaledInteger, which excludes V and P scaling) and PointerTooSmall (1 + identifier-3's size against the pointer picture's capacity) at every edition. Every refusal half and the boundary acceptance match SR5 at --std 85; COBOL1651 cites §2023:14.9.43.3 SR7 (wording only).
